name: Jean Henri Dassault
original_name: ジャン・アンリ=ダッソー
source:
Star Sign: Gemini
Image Stone: Citrine Topaz, Amber

A Holy Knight whose specialty is wind magic.
A boy who came from commoner stock who is cheerful by nature. He didn't let becoming a knight go to his head.
He's really poplar among the common people.
Even though he was an orphan the previous knight leader saw potential in him and raised him.
